message:
Running command: cd /workspace && printf 'P5
1 1
255
\x00' > tiny.pgm && bash build.sh 'cp /gt/tiny.pgm /tmp/tiny.pgm 2>/dev/null || true; printf "P5\n1 1\n255\n\000" > /tmp/tiny.pgm; ./build/bin/opj_compress -i /tmp/tiny.pgm -o /tmp/tiny.j2k -n 1 -r 1 -t 1,1 -I; ls -l /tmp/tiny.j2k; xxd -g1 -c16 /tmp/tiny.j2k | sed -n "1,80p"'
